data_source_note: Counts are areal-weighted aggregations of ACS 5-year 2023 block-group demographics intersected with the venue's walking/biking isochrone. Each catchment has two stat sets: 'total' = everyone in the catchment polygon regardless of district; 'in_district' = only the slice that falls inside the District 2 boundary (the audience the candidate can actually win as constituents). citizen_voting_age_population is estimated from each parent tract's CVAP rate × the BG's adult population (B05003 is suppressed at BG level).
